messages:
simon: Heads-up — we’re rolling a billing change tomorrow 09:00 PT. It adds a per-route micro-overage buffer (small free allowance) and a short grace throttle before hard rate limits. This is targeted at smoothing noisy PD usage spikes.
priya: quick q — will this change reserved/dedicated customer billing?
alex: nope — Dedicated/reserved contracts unchanged. This is for hosted pay-as-you-go only. Enterprise billing team will contact accounts with custom terms.
mira: TL;DR on user impact? any invoice format changes i should warn CS and partners about?
billing-bot: [automated] Preview invoice schema updated. New fields: route_overage_alloc, grace_window_seconds, smoothing_factor. Sample:
```
route: /v1/generate
usage_tokens: 12,345
route_overage_alloc: 100
grace_window_seconds: 259200  # 72h
smoothing_factor: 0.85
```
ben: I'll draft a short FAQ + snippet for the billing portal. Also recommend an email template for customers near quota.
ops-oncall: We'll add a non-escalating alert when someone crosses the micro-overage buffer; hard limit still triggers page if sustained beyond grace window.
lucy: test run done in staging — smoothing didn’t add latency, reduced token spikes in 3/3 runs.
simon: Plan: deploy tomorrow 09:00 PT, preview invoices available in Billing UI after deploy, 7-day rollback window if issues. Finance ops will coordinate customer comms for any >$500/mo accounts. Please flag concerns now.
priya: noted. tagging product and cs for awareness. @ben can you own the FAQ?
ben: yep, will post draft in #product-docs in ~2h :thumbsup:
mira: i'll prepare a short internal ops playbook and update the runbook for throttles.
simon: thanks everyone. we’ll monitor first 48h closely. :rocket:
